boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Michigan-Dearborn
boards.description: Ten currently listed, under-21-safe food and dessert destinations in Dearborn with late closing times.

cards.title: Hot&Puff
cards.subtitle: 14651 Michigan Ave, Dearborn
cards.notes: Use the official online-order link or stop in for a late meal; confirm availability before leaving because restaurant hours can change.
cards.short_summary: A Michigan Avenue restaurant whose site lists service until 3 AM every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Hot&Puff’s official site lists hours ending at 3:00 AM Sunday through Saturday and gives its address as 14651 Michigan Ave in Dearborn.
cards.source_title: Hot&Puff | American Restaurant in Dearborn, MI
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 3:00 AM closing daily; delivery and pickup are also stated as available.

cards.title: Mocha Delights
cards.subtitle: 14456 Michigan Ave, Dearborn
cards.notes: Plan a coffee, smoothie, sandwich, or dessert stop after evening commitments; check the restaurant’s order page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Michigan Avenue café with official business hours reaching 3 AM Monday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Mocha Delights’ official ordering site lists Dearborn business hours of 5 PM–3 AM Monday–Saturday and 5 PM–1 AM Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official business hours list 3:00 AM Monday–Saturday and 1:00 AM Sunday; carryout hours differ slightly.

cards.title: Ananas Cafe
cards.subtitle: 6831 Schaefer Rd, Dearborn
cards.notes: Use delivery or takeout if you need a later food-and-drink option; review the day-specific hours on the cafe’s official site first.
cards.short_summary: A Schaefer Road cafe with official late-night delivery and takeout information.
cards.evidence_claim: Ananas Cafe’s official site lists Dearborn hours until 2 AM Monday–Thursday and until 3 AM Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists closing at 2:00 AM Monday–Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday–Sunday, with delivery and takeout offered.

cards.title: Galata Sweets
cards.subtitle: 1035 Mason St, Suite 102, Dearborn
cards.notes: Make this a dessert, coffee, or tea stop and verify the day before going; the official page gives different weekday and weekend hours.
cards.short_summary: A Turkish sweets and coffee destination with late Friday and Saturday service listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Galata Sweets’ official site lists the Dearborn location open until 1 AM Sunday–Thursday and until 3 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official Dearborn hours list 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Farooj
cards.subtitle: 10386 W Warren Ave, Dearborn
cards.notes: Check the day-specific schedule and place an order through the restaurant’s official site before making the Warren Avenue trip.
cards.short_summary: A Dearborn restaurant with official late-night hours, including a 4 AM Saturday close.
cards.evidence_claim: Farooj’s official homepage lists hours until 1 AM on several days, 3 AM Friday, and 4 AM Saturday at 10386 W Warren Ave.
cards.access_notes: Official homepage lists closing at 1:00 AM Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Sunday; 3:00 AM Friday; and 4:00 AM Saturday. Closed Tuesday.

cards.title: Fratelli's Eatery
cards.subtitle: 5960 Schaefer Rd, Suite A, Dearborn
cards.notes: Use the Dearborn location listing—not the separate Dearborn Heights branch—and check its official schedule for the appropriate night.
cards.short_summary: A Schaefer Road eatery with midnight weeknight and 2 AM weekend closing times listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Fratelli’s official site lists its Dearborn location at 5960 Schaefer Rd open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 2 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Fratelli's Eatery - More Than Just Pizza
cards.access_notes: Official Dearborn-location hours are 2 PM–12 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2 PM–2 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Level Zero Smash Burgers - West Dearborn
cards.title: Level Zero Smash Burgers
cards.subtitle: 22224 Michigan Ave, Dearborn
cards.notes: Use the West Dearborn location page to confirm the destination, then order or visit within its listed daily late-hours window.
cards.short_summary: A Michigan Avenue burger destination whose official location page lists 2 AM daily closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Level Zero’s official locations page lists the West Dearborn restaurant at 22224 Michigan Ave open 11 AM–2 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 11:00 AM–2:00 AM every day for West Dearborn.

cards.entity_name: Level Zero Smash Burgers - East Dearborn
cards.title: Level Zero Smash Burgers - East Dearborn
cards.subtitle: 6914 Wyoming Ave, Dearborn
cards.notes: Choose the East Dearborn branch specifically when heading toward Wyoming Avenue, and check the official location page before travel.
cards.short_summary: A separate Level Zero location with the same officially listed 2 AM daily service window.
cards.evidence_claim: Level Zero’s official locations page lists its East Dearborn restaurant at 6914 Wyoming Ave open 11 AM–2 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 11:00 AM–2:00 AM every day for East Dearborn.

cards.title: The Canteen at Midtown
cards.subtitle: 720 Town Center Dr, Dearborn
cards.notes: Check the day of week before going, then use the venue’s ordering or directions link for a late food stop near Town Center Drive.
cards.short_summary: A multi-vendor dining destination with 11 PM weekdays and midnight Friday-Saturday hours listed.
cards.evidence_claim: The Canteen at Midtown’s official site lists hours until 11 PM Monday–Thursday and until midnight Friday–Saturday at 720 Town Center Dr.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11:00 PM Monday–Thursday, 12:00 AM Friday–Saturday, and 10:00 PM Sunday.

cards.title: Auntie Anne's Dearborn
cards.subtitle: 23341 Ford Rd, Dearborn
cards.notes: Reserve this Ford Road stop for Friday or Saturday nights and use the official location page to confirm the late-hours schedule before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A pretzel shop whose official location page lists 1 AM Friday and Saturday closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Auntie Anne’s official Dearborn location page lists hours until 1 AM on Friday and Saturday at 23341 Ford Rd.
cards.source_title: Auntie Anne's Dearborn | Freshly Baked Soft Pretzels
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 1:00 AM closing Friday and Saturday; other listed days close at 10:00 PM.
